The '''Mushroom Spore''' is a {{Common}} item.

== Obtaining ==
'''Mushroom Spores''' can be obtained from breaking Brown Mushrooms and Brown Mushroom Blocks in the {{Zone|Mystic Marsh}} or {{Zone|Scarleton}} on the [[Crimson Isle]]. Both the Mushrooms and Mushroom Blocks require the player to use a [[Spore Harvester]], which can be bought from the [[Mage Emissary]], to break them.

== Usage ==
=== [[Charminizer]] ===
{{Item|Mushroom Spore|amount=1000}}s, along with {{C|100k}} can be traded to the [[Mage Emissary]] for a [[Charminizer]].

=== [[Marsh Spore Soup]] ===
{{Item|Mushroom Spore|amount=5}}s, along with {{C|950}} can be traded to [[Ezekiel]] for a [[Marsh Spore Soup]].

=== [[Scarleton Premium]] ===
{{Item|Mushroom Spore|amount=50}}s, along with {{C|19,000}} can be traded to [[Ezekiel]] for a [[Scarleton Premium]].

== Trivia ==
*'''Mushroom Spores''' are affected by {{stat|FMF}}, unlike {{Item|Red Thornleaf}}.
